courses.title: MBSR – Mindfulness Based Stress Reduction
courses.description: João's eight-week MBSR course in Lisbon, taught in Portuguese: eight evening sessions of two and a half hours plus a six-hour retreat day. Participants learn guided mindfulness meditation and mindful movement and work with stress and difficult emotions, with audio practices and a course manual for home practice.

courses.title: Formação Profissional de Professores de MBSR (Fase 1 – Qualificação)
courses.description: A six-day residential training at the Seminário da Silva in Barcelos, the first phase of the MBSR teacher qualification that João started at Budadharma in 2026. It revisits the eight-week programme from the inside and trains facilitation, inquiry and the ethics of teaching mindfulness; applicants need to have done MBSR and a five-day silent retreat.
